original: Glenealo Valley is a national nature reserve of approximately 4,838 acres located in County Wicklow, Ireland. It is managed by the Irish National Parks & Wildlife Service, part of the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage.
translated: Glenealo Valley ist ein nationales Naturschutzgebiet von etwa 4.838 Hektar in der Grafschaft Wicklow, Irland. Es wird vom Irish National Parks & Wildlife Service verwaltet, der Teil des Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage ist.
